scenarios.name: Kwik Courier — Delivery Operations
scenarios.summary: Kwik Courier is a fictional last-mile delivery company operating in Nigeria. An operations manager has asked an analyst to investigate delivery times across city routes. The running example used throughout tile_data_quality_and_workflow and tile_stakeholder_framing_requirements: the analyst receives a delivery-orders table, checks its quality, follows the analysis workflow, and then scopes the request with the manager.
glossary_example_vocab: average Lagos delivery time rose to 30 minutes this month, up from 22 minutes last month

scenarios.name: Kwik Courier — Stakeholder Communication
scenarios.summary: The same Kwik Courier context, focused on the stakeholder-communication tile. The operations manager's vague request ('Can you look into our delivery times?') is used to teach identifying the decision need, stating findings precisely, framing the analytical question, and gathering requirements before analysis begins.
glossary_example_vocab: Is average delivery time in Lagos this month higher than last month?
Lagos delivery times have risen, so customers on that route are waiting longer
average Lagos delivery time rose to 30 minutes this month, up from 22 minutes last month
bar chart of average delivery time per city

assets.title: Kwik Courier — Delivery Orders
assets.description: One week of delivery orders for Kwik Courier across Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt. Used throughout tile_data_quality_and_workflow and tile_stakeholder_framing_requirements. The clean base has 12 rows; the 'messy' variant plants three quality issues (missing value, duplicate row, impossible value) matching the glossary's teaching examples.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Unique order number — a digit used as a label, not a quantity

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date the order was placed (YYYY-MM-DD)

columns.name: city
columns.description: Destination city for the delivery

columns.name: delivery_minutes
columns.description: Time from order dispatch to delivery confirmation, in minutes

columns.name: driver_id
columns.description: Driver identifier — a digit used as a label, not a quantity

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Customer full name — personally identifiable information

columns.name: customer_phone
columns.description: Customer phone number including country code — personally identifiable information

variants.purpose: Messy version for data-quality practice: contains a missing delivery time (completeness), a duplicate order row (uniqueness), and a negative delivery time (validity). Used in the field_selection practice anchor and the data_table visual anchor.

planted_issues.description: Order 1009 has no delivery time recorded — the cell is null. This is a completeness failure: a value that should be present is missing.
Order 1003 appears as two identical rows. This is a uniqueness failure: one entity (one order) should appear as one row.
Order 1006 has delivery_minutes = -5. A negative delivery time is not a valid delivery time — this is a validity failure.

assets.title: Kwik Courier — Stakeholder Requests and Analytical Questions
assets.description: A lookup table of six vague stakeholder requests paired with their underlying decision, a rewritten measurable analytical question, and the question's components (variable, group, intent). Used in tile_stakeholder_framing_requirements for practice anchors on identifying decision need, framing the analytical question, and identifying requirements.

columns.name: request_id
columns.description: Row identifier — a digit used as a label, not a quantity

columns.name: request_text
columns.description: The vague stakeholder request as originally stated

columns.name: decision
columns.description: The underlying business decision the analysis is meant to inform

columns.name: vague_question
columns.description: The question as first stated — vague, not yet measurable

columns.name: measurable_question
columns.description: The rewritten well-formed statistical question naming variable, group, and intent

columns.name: variable_of_interest
columns.description: The measurable variable the question focuses on

columns.name: group_or_period
columns.description: The group or time period the question focuses on

columns.name: intent
columns.description: The statistical intent: comparison, description, or association

rows: Can you look into our delivery times?
Decide whether to add more couriers on the Lagos route
Is the average delivery time in Lagos this month higher than last month?
Lagos, this month vs last month
Can you check how our drivers are doing?
Decide whether to renegotiate the contract with the courier partner
Is the average delivery time per driver in March 2024 above the 30-minute target?
Look into whether Port Harcourt is a problem.
Decide whether to expand operations in Port Harcourt or reduce them
Is the average delivery time in Port Harcourt higher than in Lagos and Abuja over the same period?
Port Harcourt vs Lagos and Abuja, March 2024
Find out if late deliveries are related to the time of day.
Decide whether to adjust dispatch scheduling to reduce late deliveries
Do late deliveries happen at certain times?
Is there an association between dispatch hour and delivery time across all orders in March 2024?
Tell me about our order volumes.
Decide whether to hire additional operations staff for peak days
How many orders do we get?
What is the average number of orders per day in Lagos during March 2024?
Decide whether to invest in a customer-satisfaction improvement programme
What proportion of orders in March 2024 were delivered within the 30-minute target across all cities?

assets.title: Kwik Courier — Vague vs Precise Finding Statements
assets.description: Five pairs of vague and precise finding statements drawn from the Kwik Courier scenario. The first row matches the glossary's exact teaching example. Used in tile_stakeholder_framing_requirements for the before_after visual anchor and the external_proof practice anchor on stating findings precisely.

columns.name: finding_id
columns.description: Row identifier — a digit used as a label, not a quantity

columns.name: vague_finding
columns.description: The imprecise finding statement — lacks a specific number or comparison

columns.name: precise_finding
columns.description: The rewritten precise finding — names a specific number and includes a comparison

columns.name: has_specific_number
columns.description: True if the precise finding names at least one specific number

columns.name: has_comparison
columns.description: True if the precise finding includes a comparison to a prior period or group

columns.name: is_complete_sentence
columns.description: True if the precise finding is a complete sentence with a subject and verb

rows: The average Lagos delivery time rose to 30 minutes this month, up from 22 minutes last month.
Kwik Courier completed 12 delivery orders in the sample week, with Lagos accounting for 5 of those orders — the highest share of any city.
The average delivery time in Port Harcourt was 25 minutes in March 2024, compared with 30 minutes in Lagos over the same period.
Driver 202 completed both assigned orders in March 2024 with an average delivery time of 21 minutes, the lowest among the five active drivers.
83% of orders in March 2024 were delivered within the 30-minute target, up from 71% in February 2024.
